text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye was signing message cards
as replies to her fan letters, but—
choice_data_list: Ai, can you handle all this...?
Ai, can you handle all this...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Yeah.
Honestly, I think it's going to get tough soon.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Give back what you've received.
I've lived by that feeling until now, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The way I'm doing things now, I'll reach my limit paying them back sooner or later.
...I need to change my approach.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And so, from now on, I think
I'll reply to everyone on stream.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Right! That way, tons of people can see it all at once, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "There's just one problem... I want to make sure only the people who sent fan letters can watch it..."
choice_data_list: I see... Oh, in that case!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
! I did it, Trainer, I did it!
Stream settings via invite URL... with this, we're set!
choice_data_list: Alright, looks like we can do the exclusive stream with this.
Okay, looks like we can do the exclusive stream with this!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: So all I have to do next time is send a card with this URL on it in return... You're a genius!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the flavor! ...Alright!
"Ai's Special Lightly Pickled Cucumbers" recipe, complete!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, preparations progressed little by little—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—To everyone who sent me fan letters,
welcome to Ai's Fan Letter Reply Stream!
It's only for a short time, but please enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
To start off, this is the Trainer's office
that we usually use.

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"The trainer's room!"
"Oh~ so this is what it's like."
"What kind of stuff do you do in here?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. We always come up with strategies
and have lunch meetings together right here.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And today! I've come up with Ai's special recipe
for the 'quick-pickled cucumbers' she often eats
for lunch, so let's get cooking!

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Cucumber!"
"Right now?!"
"And now the cooking show begins."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the stream continued smoothly...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Now, to wrap things up, I'm going
to reply to every single one of you!

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, every single person?!" "Is she a fan service god?"
"That's gonna take forever."
"Does that mean she'll say my name?!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Sora-san, thank you for the cute portrait!
Endo-san, best of luck on your art college entrance exams.
Hiyoko-san, I'm so happy to have support from both parent and child--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye spent over an hour replying to everyone before successfully wrapping up the stream.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks for today.
For indulging my self-satisfaction.
choice_data_list: No, no... I want to try a lot more things next time.
No, no... Let's try a lot more things next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
!
Fufu. Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, we'll need to show even more progress than today.
...Let's have a strategy meeting over some pickled vegetables!"
